prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production sprite-atlas asset for the KeLing gamified learning app: EXACTLY TWELVE separate illustrated miniature knowledge planets arranged in a perfectly regular THREE-column by FOUR-row grid, equal square cells, portrait aspect 3:4. Reference image is STYLE AND COLOR reference only. Match its exquisite handmade pixel-art contours, deep navy outlines, mint/teal surfaces, ivory architecture, restrained gold highlights, small coral accents. NOT 3D render, not emoji, not vector logos. Each sprite is a full spherical tiny world with an interesting detailed thematic landscape, gentle isometric buildings on its surface, clearly visible planet curvature, and tasteful sparse orbit accents. Each sprite stays entirely in its own cell with 12% transparent padding, equal optical size, no overlap, no outside scenery. True transparent background, all negative space transparent, no labels, no typography, no grid lines, no watermark, no mascot. Important semantic order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
Row1 mathematics: mint geometric globe with triangular bridge, compass instrument, stepped polyhedra and curved coordinate orbit; English: turquoise globe with open ivory book architecture, tiny dialogue bubble shaped satellites, letter-block tower with only minimal A B motifs; history: warm sandstone globe with ancient Chinese gate, small column ruin and scroll road.
Row2 computer science: navy/teal circuit-world with microchip tower, binary-tree-shaped luminous circuit paths, tiny terminal building; economics: jade commercial-world with small market pavilions, gold coin stacks and rising trade bridge; politics/civics: sage-and-ivory civic-world with solemn assembly hall, balanced scales, linked community plaza (no real party symbols).
Row3 Chinese language/literature: pale jade world with flowing scroll landscape, ink brush monument, elegant pavilion; physics: blue world with orbital atom observatory, pendulum tower, prism with narrow light ray; chemistry: mint/lavender world with glass flask towers and ball-and-stick molecular gardens.
Row4 biology: lush green world with leaf canopy, DNA helix monument and cellular dome; geography: ocean blue world with discernible continents, mountains, tiny compass and map-route orbit; arts: coral/teal world with painter palette island, musical-note sculpture and small theater pavilion.
Create coherent exquisite game artwork with enough planet-body color distinction for recognition while retaining restrained teal, cream and gold visual unity. All twelve full planets must be present and correctly ordered.
